name: tradebee
description: A unified Tradebee Website Builder Open API skill that exposes multiple Tradebee operations through a single action-based entrypoint, including tenant HTML rule retrieval, blog create/read/update/delete, blog group create/read/update/delete, FAQ create/read/update/delete, FAQ group create/read/update/delete, custom page create/read/update/delete, product group create/read/update/delete, product create/read/update/delete, inquiry reads, recent visitor reads, and keyword ranking analytics. Update actions also read the current record and write a local JSON backup file before sending the Tradebee update request.
